scope: Prevent abbreviations, implementation containers, visual branches, and symbolic module titles from being misread as project renames.

sources.meaning: Prior identity invariant and initial typed aliases.
Historical usage includes MC as abbreviation and Liminal Thread as a visual branch label; raw private text is not reproduced.
Atlas is a project document family and volume title, not a project rename.
General Field Engine is a derived compendium/module family, not established as the canonical project identity.

classification_rules.rule: Only an explicit project-level rename decision may replace the canonical project name.
Repository, folder, package, branch, framework, deployment, document-series, volume, mode, and visual-branch labels remain typed child entities.
Abbreviations and misspellings may resolve to the canonical entity but must retain their raw observed form and provenance.
An alias with insufficient context remains unresolved rather than being promoted to canonical status.

claims.claim: Mirror Cartographer is the canonical project identity in current operational state.
Historical records use MC, Liminal Thread, Atlas, General Field Engine, and multiple repository or folder labels.
These labels occupy different entity roles and should not be flattened into one name-history sequence.
Future continuity mining should emit one registry row per raw occurrence with source, date, entity type, confidence, and lifecycle status.
Every capitalized or branded phrase associated with the work is a former project name.
The exact lifecycle status of Liminal Thread and General Field Engine requires stronger decision-log evidence.

contradictions_resolved.contradiction: Historical materials present several branded labels near Mirror Cartographer, which can look like renames when stripped of their structural role.
contradictions_resolved.resolution: Treat each label as a typed entity. Only explicit project-level rename evidence can alter canonical identity.

privacy_boundary.included: Project labels, technical containers, document-series names, abstract relationships, and source titles.
privacy_boundary.excluded: Raw private conversations, personal interpretations, health information, relationship material, finances, and identifying narrative context.

next_action: Implement a deterministic scanner schema that records every alias occurrence without copying private source passages and flags lifecycle-status conflicts for review.
